home.zhCheck.title: New: Putonghua with tone checks
home.zhCheck.body.adult: A one-minute speaking check to find which tones and sounds to practise first.
home.zhCheck.body.kid: A one-minute speaking check so Tutu knows which tones and sounds to practise first.
home.practiceMode.title: Practice mode — scores are simulated.
home.practiceMode.code.adult: Enter an invite code in Settings & privacy to switch on real pronunciation scoring.
home.practiceMode.code.kid: A grown-up can enter an invite code in the Parent Zone to switch on real pronunciation scoring.
home.practiceMode.notConnected: Real pronunciation scoring isn’t connected on this device.
home.hero.finished: Unit finished — keep your sounds sharp!
home.focus.label: Today’s pronunciation focus
home.daily.title: Today’s goal
home.talk.sub: Have a real conversation out loud — at a café, the zoo, with a new friend
home.twisters.title: Tongue twisters
home.twisters.sub: Say it right, say it fast — and see the leaderboard
home.book.notice.noCodeSet: This Wunder Tutor server has no invite code set yet, so photos can’t be read. Typed English works.
home.book.notice.refused.kid: This device’s invite code isn’t accepted any more. A grown-up can enter it again in {settings} → Invite code. Typed English works without it.
home.book.notice.refused.adult: This device’s invite code isn’t accepted any more. Enter it again in {settings} → Invite code. Typed English works without it.
home.book.notice.needsCode.kid: Photos need the invite code. A grown-up can add it in {settings} → Invite code. Typed English works without it.
home.book.notice.needsCode.adult: Photos need the invite code. Add it in {settings} → Invite code. Typed English works without it.
home.book.notice.unavailable: Reading photos isn’t switched on yet on the Wunder Tutor server. Typed English works.
home.book.start.title.adult: Practise anything with words on it
home.book.start.body.kid: A book, a sign, a menu — take a photo. Listen to each sentence, say it, and get help with every word.
home.book.start.body.adult: Photograph a page of a book, a menu or a sign. Hear each sentence, say it, and get corrected.
home.book.page.nothing: Nothing here can be checked yet
home.book.delete.title: Delete this page?
home.book.delete.body: Its sentences and scores are removed from this device. Your other pages stay.
home.book.full: My book holds {n} pages, so the oldest page made room for this one.
home.book.fineprint: Your pages are saved on this device only. To read a photo or speak a sentence, it is sent to Google’s Gemini: Wunder Tutor’s servers don’t keep it, and Google may keep it for a short time under its API terms.
home.book.fineprint.device: Your pages are saved on this device only.
home.camera.aria: Camera: take a photo of a page
home.camera.title: Say it right
home.camera.problem.blocked: The camera is switched off for Wunder Tutor. Allow it in your browser, or use the camera app.
home.camera.problem.none: No camera was found here. Choose a photo instead.
home.camera.problem.failed: The camera didn’t start. Use the camera app, or choose a photo.
home.camera.noPicture: The camera didn’t give a picture. Try again, or use the phone’s camera.
home.camera.hint.kid: Get the whole page in the picture, then tap the white button
home.camera.hint.adult: Get the whole page in the picture, then tap
home.camera.blurry: Blurry? Use the phone’s camera instead
home.read.error.offline: No internet right now — try again when you’re back online.
home.read.error.busy: That was a lot of pages! Wait a few minutes, then try again.
home.read.error.limit: Your family has read today’s pages: the limit starts again tomorrow. Typed English still works.
home.read.error.locked: This device’s invite code isn’t accepted — it may have been changed. Enter it again to read pages.
home.read.error.lockout: Too many wrong codes were tried from this network, so even the right one is turned away for now. Wait 10 minutes, then enter the code again.
home.read.error.unavailable: Reading pages isn’t switched on yet on the Wunder Tutor server.{detail}
home.read.error.photo: That photo couldn’t be opened. Take a new one, or choose a JPEG or PNG.
home.read.error.failed: Reading didn’t work this time — a hiccup on our side, not your photo. Try again in a moment.{detail}
home.read.error.serverSetup: Reading pages isn’t working yet — a setup problem on the Wunder Tutor server, not your photo.{detail}
home.read.error.quota: The reading service is busy right now. Try again in a minute.{detail}
home.read.error.declined: Google’s reader wouldn’t read this page. Try another page, or type the words instead.{detail}
home.read.nothing.kid: I couldn’t find any words. Hold the book closer, in good light.
home.read.nothing.adult: No text found. Hold the page closer, in good light.
home.read.nothing.otherLanguage: Wunder Tutor can check English and Putonghua for now.
home.read.setup.noCodeSet: This Wunder Tutor server has no invite code set yet, so no code can unlock it.
home.read.setup.needsCode: Reading pages needs the invite code.
home.read.setup.broken: Reading pages isn’t working yet: {state} (Google). It’s a setup problem on the Wunder Tutor server, not your camera.
